steps.title: MOVE
steps.tip: Hold {MOVERIGHT} to run to the right.

steps.title: JUMP
steps.body: Tap {JUMP} for a hop. Hold {JUMP} to jump higher: do a full, high jump.
steps.tip: Keep {JUMP} held until the top of the jump.

steps.title: SLIDE
steps.body: While running, press {SLIDE} for a burst of speed.
steps.tip: You must be running first: hold a direction, then press {SLIDE}.

steps.title: ATTACK
steps.body: Strike with {ATTACK}. Grunts die to any hit.
steps.tip: Face the grunt and press {ATTACK} when it is close.

steps.title: KILL CHAIN
steps.body: Kills give speed back. Kill three grunts quickly, one after another, to chain.
steps.tip: Run into the group and keep pressing {ATTACK}: each kill must follow the last one fast.

steps.title: WALL JUMP
steps.body: Jump into a wall, then press {JUMP} again to kick off it. Climb to the top of the shaft.
steps.tip: Press {JUMP} each time you touch a wall: bounce from side to side.

steps.title: HOOK
steps.body: Hold {HOOK} to fire the hook up and forward at the block above, and swing.
steps.tip: Stand a few steps before the block, face it and hold {HOOK}. Keep holding.

steps.title: FLING
steps.body: Swing, then let go of {HOOK} at the bottom of the swing. Fly past the marker.
steps.tip: Run at the block, jump, hold {HOOK}, and let go just as you pass under it.

steps.title: SPEED TIERS
steps.body: Speed is power: your tier (1-3) sets how hard you hit. Reach tier 3.
steps.tip: Fling off a swing, or slide and then jump off a wall: running alone is not fast enough.

steps.title: BRUTE
steps.body: Armoured below tier 3. Hit it at tier 3, or dodge its charge so it crashes into the wall.
steps.tip: Jump over the charge. A crashed brute is dazed and its armour is down: strike it then.

steps.title: DRONE
steps.body: It hovers out of reach, holds still, then dives. Dodge the dive and strike it while it is low.
steps.tip: Run aside when it stops above you, then {ATTACK} as it climbs back up.

steps.title: SHOOTER
steps.body: Press {ATTACK} as its shot reaches you to send it back.
steps.tip: Stand still facing the shooter and strike just before the shot hits.

steps.title: SHIELD
steps.body: Its shield blocks strikes from the front. Hit it from behind or from above.
steps.tip: Jump over it and strike its back before it turns, or {ATTACK} while falling onto it.

steps.title: KAMIKAZE
steps.body: It rushes you and lights a fuse. Kill it before the fuse ends, or get clear of the blast.
steps.tip: Strike it as it arrives, or run the other way the moment it stops and flashes.

steps.title: SUMMONER
steps.body: It runs away and summons drones until it dies. Chase it down.
steps.tip: Corner it against a wall. A hit during its cast stops the summon.

steps.title: ORBS
steps.body: Enemies sometimes drop orbs. Grab all three: health, speed, and hook.
steps.tip: Run over each orb before it fades. Buffs show under your speed meter.
